title: Inside, matter is crushed into a superfluid and superconducting state.
purpose: Describe the exotic interior of neutron stars.
narration: Inside a neutron star, matter is crushed into a superfluid of neutrons and a superconducting state of protons. This exotic material has zero viscosity and zero electrical resistance, allowing electric currents to flow forever.
